admission.justification: Spans read_only.py and server.py, is guarded by test_read_only_annotations_merges_site_hints_and_central_read_only_wins, and prevents registration sites from either losing valid hints or overriding the fail-closed central read_only_hint partition.

applicability: Every MCP tool registered on AgentsRememberMCP when enforce_read_only_marks=True.
conditions: Registration optionally supplies ToolAnnotations carrying non-read-only hints such as title, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, or openWorldHint.
exclusions: Bare test AgentsRememberMCP instances created with enforce_read_only_marks=False.
statement: Tool annotation registration merges site-declared hints with the central fail-closed read_only_hint so central classification always wins and unclassified tools still raise UnknownReadOnlyMark.
title: ToolAnnotations merge site hints while central readOnlyHint wins
